summary: 所选范围为微软2025财年10-K第一部分“Operating Segments”小节,涵盖三个报告分部(生产力与业务流程、智能云、更多个人计算)及其下源文列出的业务组、命名产品/平台及其关系图。仅为该小节的对象与关系图,不代表整份报告或公司全部产品;客户、变现与财务属性在本阶段推迟。

businesses.name: MICROSOFT CORPORATION
businesses.description: 微软公司,按三个分部经营并报告财务业绩。

excerpts.quote: MICROSOFT CORPORATION
We operate our business and report our financial performance using three segments

businesses.name: Productivity and Business Processes
businesses.description: 由生产力、通信和信息服务产品与服务组合构成的报告分部,覆盖多种设备和平台。

excerpts.quote: Productivity and Business Processes
consists of products and services in our portfolio of productivity, communication, and information services, spanning a variety of devices and platforms

businesses.name: Intelligent Cloud
businesses.description: 由公有、私有和混合云服务器产品及云服务构成的报告分部,为现代企业和开发者提供支撑。

excerpts.quote: Intelligent Cloud
consists of our public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services that power modern business and developers

businesses.name: More Personal Computing
businesses.description: 由以客户体验为中心的产品与服务构成的报告分部。

excerpts.quote: More Personal Computing
consists of products and services that put customers at the center of the experience with our technology

businesses.name: Microsoft 365 Commercial products and cloud services
businesses.description: 含Microsoft 365 Commercial云服务及本地部署产品(Windows Commercial本地版、Office本地授权)的商业产品与云服务组。

excerpts.quote: Microsoft 365 Commercial products and cloud services
Microsoft 365 Commercial products, comprising Windows Commercial on-premises and Office licensed on-premises

businesses.name: Microsoft 365 Commercial
businesses.description: 整合Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot和Enterprise Mobility + Security的AI驱动商业与生产力解决方案平台。

excerpts.quote: Microsoft 365 Commercial is an AI-powered business and productivity solutions platform
brings together Office, Windows, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Enterprise Mobility + Security

businesses.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
businesses.description: Microsoft 365 Commercial云服务中列出的组成部分。

excerpts.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot

comprising Microsoft 365 Commercial, Enterprise Mobility + Security, the cloud portion of Windows Commercial, the per-user portion of Power BI, Exchange, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Security and Compliance, and Microsoft 365 Copilot

businesses.name: Enterprise Mobility + Security
businesses.description: Microsoft 365 Commercial云服务中列出的组成部分,与身份和安全厂商等竞争。

excerpts.quote: Enterprise Mobility + Security
Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud, comprising Microsoft 365 Commercial, Enterprise Mobility + Security

businesses.name: Microsoft 365 Consumer products and cloud services
businesses.description: 含Microsoft 365 Consumer订阅、Office本地授权及其他消费者服务的消费者产品与云服务组。

excerpts.quote: Microsoft 365 Consumer products and cloud services
including Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriptions, Office licensed on-premises, and other consumer services

businesses.name: Microsoft 365 Consumer
businesses.description: 旨在通过一系列产品与服务提升个人生产力和创造力。

excerpts.quote: Microsoft 365 Consumer
is designed to increase personal productivity and creativity through a range of products and services

LinkedIn connects the world’s professionals to make them more productive and successful

Dynamics provides cloud-based and on-premises business solutions for financial management, enterprise resource planning (“ERP”), customer relationship management (“CRM”), and supply chain management

including Azure and other cloud services

businesses.name: Azure
businesses.description: 一套全面的云服务,供开发者、IT专业人员和企业在任意平台或设备上构建、部署和管理应用。

Azure is a comprehensive set of cloud services that offer developers, IT professionals, and enterprises freedom to build, deploy, and manage applications on any platform or device

businesses.name: GitHub

excerpts.quote: GitHub
GitHub provides a collaboration platform for developers to manage code and incorporate AI and agent-based tools across the software development lifecycle

excerpts.quote: Enterprise and partner services

businesses.description: Xbox内容与服务中列出的云游戏服务。

excerpts.quote: Xbox Cloud Gaming
Xbox hardware and Xbox content and services, comprising first- and third-party content (including games and in-game content), Xbox Game Pass and other subscriptions, Xbox Cloud Gaming

businesses.description: 旨在向全球受众提供相关搜索、原生和展示广告的业务,含Bing和Copilot、Microsoft News、Microsoft Edge及第三方联盟。

excerpts.quote: Search and news advertising

businesses.name: Bing
businesses.description: 与Copilot结合的搜索引擎,是获取和留住用户的关键工具。

excerpts.quote: Bing search engine
Our Microsoft Edge browser and Bing search engine with Copilot are key tools to enable user acquisition and engagement

businesses.name: Microsoft Copilot
